My top pick is the Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W) for most MacBook Pro owners who want premium charging performance. If you want the best value, a lighter option, or a lower price, there are good alternatives in your supplied search results.

Best power banks for MacBook Pro
Best overall

Anker Prime Power Bank (26K, 300W)

High performance · Premium pick

Macworld names it best overall, highlighting its large capacity, up to 140W USB-C PD 3.1 charging, 300W total output, and fast recharging. It doesn't have a built-in cable.

Source: Macworld's 2026 laptop power bank guide

 Shop Anker Prime

Best built-in cable

EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K (300W)

27,650mAh · 99.54Wh · Up to 140W

A strong choice for a 14-inch or 16-inch MacBook Pro. It includes a retractable USB-C cable, supports up to 300W total output, and can charge multiple devices. Its 99.54Wh capacity is close to the usual 100Wh airline limit.

Source: Macworld's EcoFlow review

 Shop EcoFlow

Best budget pick in the supplied results

Baseus Blade H1 100W (20,000mAh)

$89.99

100W USB-C PD · About 74Wh · 451g

The practical value option for everyday laptop top-ups. It has two USB-C and two USB-A ports, pass-through charging, a display, and a 100W USB-C cable included. Expect reduced laptop power when charging multiple devices.

Source: Dealectric's product details and price

 Buy Baseus Blade H1

Anker Laptop Power Bank 25K

25,000mAh · 90Wh · Built-in cables

Engadget's overall laptop power bank pick in its 2026 guide. Its two built-in USB-C cables make it convenient for travel, and the supplied test results report about 0.68 MacBook Pro charges in 53 minutes. Note that the tested laptop model and exact charging conditions matter.

Source: Engadget's 2026 laptop power bank guide

 Shop Anker

Which wattage should you buy?

Your priority

	

Recommended output




Everyday MacBook Pro charging

	

100W USB-C PD




Faster charging on compatible newer models

	

140W USB-C PD 3.1




Charging multiple devices or two laptops

	

200–300W total output

Your MacBook's maximum charging speed depends on its model and the power bank's supported USB-C PD profile. A higher total wattage doesn't necessarily mean one port can deliver that full amount.

For flights: Most travelers should look for a battery below 100Wh and carry it in their cabin baggage, not checked luggage. Airline and route rules can vary, so confirm them before flying.

My recommendation

Best overall: Anker Prime 26K, 300W.

Best convenience: EcoFlow RAPID Pro 27K, with its built-in cable.

Best value: Baseus Blade H1, 100W, at the supplied $89.99 price.

One question that would help me narrow this down: Which MacBook Pro do you have — 14-inch or 16-inch, and what chip or year? That determines whether paying extra for 140W charging is worthwhile.
